column1: wants
I want to find the person who stole my shadow on my tenth birthday.
I want to open a ramen shop that the dead and the living can both visit.
I want to learn why my mother erased me from her memories.
I want to design a memory that everyone in the city can share without fighting.
I want to repay a kindness I received from a stranger forty years ago.
I want to become ordinary for just one full day.
I want to prove that the extinct sky whales are still alive.
I want to finish the novel my late partner started.
I want to be forgiven by the town I accidentally flooded.
I want to find a place where my power does not hurt anyone.
I want to hear my own voice for the first time.
I want to win back my name from the demon I sold it to.
I want to build a school for monsters who want to become human.
I want to see the ocean before my body turns completely to stone.
I want to rescue my little brother from the dream he never woke up from.
I want to replace the god of my village, who has grown tired.
I want to deliver a letter that has been undeliverable for three hundred years.
I want to be remembered by at least one person after I disappear.
I want to find out which of my clones is the original.
I want to make my estranged father laugh once before he dies.
I want to buy back the island my ancestors lost in a card game.
I want to stop the festival that sacrifices one wish every year.
I want to become the first robot to be granted a funeral.
I want to cure the sadness that turned my hometown gray.
I want to find the song that ends all wars, which my grandmother hummed.
I want to escape the story I was written into.
I want to plant a forest on the moon for my late dog.
I want to know what I was before I was reincarnated.
I want to return the stars I accidentally knocked out of the sky.
I want to make the city's streetlights sing again.
I want to earn enough luck to save my sister's failing restaurant.
I want to find the one mirror that shows my real face.
I want to teach my rival how to lose without breaking.
I want to live long enough to see my apprentice surpass me.
I want to break the promise that binds me to the mountain.
I want to prove that monsters can be heroes on live television.
I want to win the cooking contest that my father rigged against me.
I want to recover the color of the sky that my people forgot.
I want to be loved without using my powers.
I want to finish repairing the clock that controls my village's time.
I want to reunite the band that broke up when the world ended.
I want to discover who has been leaving flowers at my future grave.
I want to find a cure for the curse that makes me forget every Sunday.
I want to become a real hero instead of a stunt double.
I want to bring my hometown back from the bottom of the lake.
I want to hear my late teacher's voice one more time.
I want to earn the right to leave the library I was born in.
I want to prove I am not the villain the prophecy described.
I want to marry the ghost who haunts my apartment.
I want to rebuild the bridge between the two feuding villages.
I want to retire and grow tomatoes in peace.
I want to find the dragon that promised to eat me when I turned thirty.
I want to become the mayor of the underground city.
I want to understand why the stars keep sending me messages.
I want to repair my friendship with the AI I betrayed.
I want to make the ugliest monster in the world feel beautiful.
I want to rescue the lighthouse keeper who vanished during the storm.
I want to trade my immortality for one ordinary lifetime.
I want to find the recipe that tastes like my first memory.
I want to collect every lost umbrella in the world.
I want to rewrite the ending of my favorite tragedy.
I want to become the kind of adult I needed as a child.
I want to make peace between the sea people and the fishermen.
I want to find out who replaced my family with perfect copies.
I want to earn a medal from the country that exiled me.
I want to stop the rumor that I am already dead.
I want to learn to sleep without dreaming of the war.
I want to get my stolen heart back from the museum.
I want to become a comedian in a world that forgot how to laugh.
I want to give the forest spirits a vote in the city council.
I want to find a new home for the last dragon egg.
I want to break my family's thousand-year-old habit of betrayal.
I want to beat the champion who stole my title with cheating.
I want to rebuild the robot that raised me.
I want to taste snow before I go back to the stars.
I want to open a detective agency for crimes nobody reports.
I want to find the other half of the map tattooed on my back.
I want to protect my town's last cinema from demolition.
I want to find the person who can hear my thoughts.
I want to make my mother proud without becoming like her.
I want to escape from the time loop that restarts every Tuesday.
I want to erase the one mistake the whole world remembers me for.
I want to find the melody that wakes the sleeping giant.
I want to buy freedom for the spirits trapped in the vending machines.
I want to learn how to cry.
I want to deliver my grandmother's last recipe to her first love.
I want to become a better villain than my famous father.
I want to stop aging backwards before I disappear.
I want to prove that my invention can end hunger.
I want to find where the missing hours of my life went.
I want to make the moon notice me.
I want to find a friend who is not afraid of my power.
I want to bring back the festival my town forgot.
I want to win the war without killing anyone.
I want to become human before the next cherry blossom season.
I want to recover the memories I sold to pay for my sister's surgery.
I want to see my creator one last time and ask why.
I want to go home, although I no longer remember where it is.
I want to finish the pilgrimage my ancestors abandoned.
I want to teach the world to see ghosts without fear.
